What is the area of the shark's fin falcata?

From the diagram, slice the shaded region horizontally for 0 ≤ y ≤ 3: each horizontal slice runs from the right side of the smaller circle to the right side of the larger circle. From the text, the large circle is x^2 + y^2 = 9, so its right boundary is x = sqrt(9 - y^2). The smaller circle is x^2 + (y - 3/2)^2 = (3/2)^2, so its right boundary is x = sqrt((3/2)^2 - (y - 3/2)^2). Therefore the area is ∫_0^3 [sqrt(9 - y^2) - sqrt((3/2)^2 - (y - 3/2)^2)] dy. Evaluate the first integral as the area of a quarter circle of radius 3 and the second as the area of a semicircle of radius 3/2, giving 9π/4 - 9π/8 = 9π/8.
